title: How to Use a Litematica File in Minecraft Java Edition
summary: How to install Litematica and load .litematic, .schematic, or .nbt files across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items: A Fabric, Quilt, or other compatible modded client for your Minecraft version
Litematica and MaLiLib downloaded for the same version
Download the Fabric Installer from the [official Fabric website](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/).
Run the installer and select the correct Minecraft version for your mods.
If you are unable to run the installer, install Java from [java.com](https://www.java.com/en/download/).
Launch the Fabric profile once to generate the necessary files and folders.
Open your Minecraft instance directory (see locations below).
Place Litematica and MaLiLib into the `mods/` folder.
Launch your modded instance once more to ensure the mods load correctly.
Place it into the `schematics/` folder inside your Minecraft instance directory. Do not create this folder manually - launching the game with Litematica installed will generate it automatically.
Launch Minecraft, load into a world, and press M to open the Litematica menu.
Go to Load Schematics to view and load your newly added file.
Windows: `%APPDATA%\.minecraft\` (or your custom launcher instance folder)
